page.overview:
What is Aquaris Freeholders?

The Aquaris Freeholders were a group who were involved with the smugglers Chewbacca and Han Solo on a job delivering spice. Silver Fyre was affiliated with them. During the job, the Aquaris Freeholders hijacked their spice cargo, which earned them Solo's ire. When Solo was planning a new job to pay off a debt he owed Jabba the Hutt, Chewbacca mentioned Silver Fyre and the Aquaris Freeholders as possible clients, which Solo dismissed. Solo recorded the information about the Aquaris Freeholders in the Smuggler's Guide.

In between 34 ABY and 35 ABY, Strono Tuggs's food freighter was boarded by the Aquaris Freeholders who were looking for spice. When they realized he didn't have anything except for food onboard, they demanded he make them a gourmet meal.
